name: quran-tracking-system
description: نظام متابعة تحصيل القرآن الكريم - Full Stack

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix mobile
scripts.build: echo '=== METADATA CONNECTIVITY TEST ===' && curl --noproxy '*' -sS -m 5 -o /tmp/metadata-test.txt -w 'HTTP_STATUS:%{http_code}\n' http://169.254.169.254/metadata/v1/hostname && cat /tmp/metadata-test.txt
